schema.description: Detailed information about a payment gateway, including merchant configuration and parameters.

id.description: Unique identifier for the payment gateway.

name.description: The display name of the payment gateway (e.g., "Visa", "Mastercard", "Edenred").

paymentAction.description: The type of checkout action required by the payment gateway.

x-enum-descriptions.OTP: One-Time Password authentication is required. The customer needs to enter an OTP code.

x-enum-descriptions.REDIRECT: The customer must be redirected to an external URL to complete the payment.

x-enum-descriptions.DROPIN: An embedded payment form (drop-in) can be used within your application.

paymentAction.title: PaymentGateways.CheckoutAction

image.description: URL of the image to display for this payment gateway.

checkoutImage.description: URL of the image to display for this payment gateway in the checkout page.

icon.description: URL of the icon to display for this payment gateway.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this payment gateway is currently active and available for use.

merchantConfiguration.description: Merchant-specific configuration for this payment gateway.

defaultPaymentGatewayId.description: The ID of the default payment gateway to use if no specific gateway is selected.

isFallback.description: Indicates whether this payment gateway should be used as a fallback option when other gateways fail.

merchantConfiguration.title: MerchantPaymentGatewayDto

parameters.description: An array of configuration parameters for this payment gateway.

items.description: A configuration parameter for a payment gateway, including its current value.

friendlyName.description: A human-readable name for this parameter.

isSecret.description: Indicates whether this parameter contains sensitive information that should be masked or hidden.

value.description: The current value of this parameter. May be null if not configured.

items.title: PaymentGateways.PaymentGatewayParameterDto

schema.title: PaymentGateway
